blind.description: A compact, four-sided tapered pillar or marker made of dark reddish-brown weathered stone or metal. It features beveled vertical edges, shallow recessed rectangular panels on each facet, a banded collar near the top, and a rounded cap with a cylindrical socket or hole in the center. The surfaces are solid, continuous, and sit flush on the floor without an extra pedestal.
blind.from_above: A rounded square profile with chamfered edges and a distinct circular hollow socket centered in the top surface.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.3 feet tall (around 40% of the figure's height) and roughly 1 foot wide.

notes: gemini note: top features a cylindrical socket/hole
